criticals.note: The facts are right, but the decision has already been made: DESIGN_NOTES:97-103 define four clocks, and 05b names the exact fields to rebate. Rework is mechanical (rename and re-unit about 10 fields, add elapsedWatches to WorldState) and scheduled before 06 consumes the fields. Two residuals are real: (1) legacy scars carry worldTick, which the notes define as a serial rather than time, and scars are exported in CivilizationLegacyState, so the saved shape is wrong before 05b lands; (2) 05b must land before 06/06a/06b/09 add time-bearing schema (this is S1-R6). Treat as a sequencing gate on 05b, and stamp scars with elapsedWatches in 05b. Not critical.

criticals.note: The claim is accurate and the best case against it is that utility AI (06) is the change that will add behavior selection and commit, and that adding an optional cause field to effects is additive. That case partly wins: nothing shipped produces effects from NPC behavior yet, so the volume of code needing rework is small (the effect union, one reducer and the coordinator). It does not fully win because the Act shape determines the design of 06 (Leverage Chains), 06a (exposure and rumor), 06b (attribution) and 07 (what a conversation can reference), and because P4 inference trails and the S1-R2 accepted action are unbuildable without it. The telemetry already has an actor concept, so the cheap form exists: an effect envelope {effect, actorId, causeActId, watch}. Decide the shape in the 05b/06 proposals as a precondition, not as an after-thought; major rather than critical because no shipped code has to be reworked, only the unwritten code built on it.

criticals.note: True that no knowledge model exists in design or code, and S1-R5 (notebook) and the P2 generation plan both need one. But it is a new additive state slice (StateSliceKey pattern exists), nothing shipped depends on it, and its reference text is in an obsolete change. The reworks it could force are in Regard.exposure semantics (06a) and ConversationHistory (07), both unwritten. It depends on S2-02, since beliefs are derived from perceived Acts. Major: decide the model (Fact/Belief with source and learnedWatch, tiered and sparse) before 06a and 07 are proposed; not critical.
